situation: Ordered a 3-seat sofa from Hartwell Home, order HH-40718, delivered yesterday with a big tear in the back cushion. Paid $1,240. Want it fixed without a war.
reply:
Hi,
Order HH-40718, placed 2 September, delivered yesterday: the grey Arlo 3-seat sofa arrived with a 10cm tear along the back of the left cushion (photos attached). I'd like a replacement cushion sent out, and I'm happy for your team to collect the damaged one when it's delivered. Could you confirm the plan by Friday?
Thanks,
Owen Park, 555-0142
note: Reference and date first, the fault factually, one specific ask and a deadline. Asking for the cushion, not the whole sofa, is proportionate and easy to approve.

situation: 在某外卖平台点了一份168的烤鸭套餐，送到的时候少了一份鸭架汤和两张饼，打商家电话没人接。想在平台上找客服。
reply: 你好，订单号 2026092811438，今天中午12:10送达，168元的烤鸭双人套餐少了鸭架汤和两份薄饼（照片已上传）。我12:20和12:35各打了一次商家电话，都没人接。希望能退还缺失部分的费用，或者补送一份，两个都可以。麻烦今天之内给个答复，谢谢！
note: 订单号、事实、已经尝试过的、一个明确的要求、期限，客服拿着就能处理。

situation: Emailed my gym (FitCore) twice to cancel my membership after moving cities, they keep charging me $49/month. Their first reply was just a script saying cancellations need to be in person. I moved 400 miles away.
reply: Thanks for your reply. I don't think that resolves it, since I moved to Portland on 1 August, 400 miles from any FitCore branch, and sent my written cancellation on 3 August (attached). I'd like this escalated to a manager. To restate: I'm asking you to cancel membership #FC-22817 and refund the $49 charges from September and October. I'd rather settle this directly than through a card dispute, and I'm confident we can.
note: If this gets another scripted no, tell them the chargeback date once, then file it.

situation: We had my dad's 70th birthday dinner at Rosalind's on Saturday, party of 8, and booked the private room back in August with a $200 deposit. They sat us in the main dining room next to the kitchen door and nobody explained why.
reply:
Hi,
We had a party of eight at Rosalind's on Saturday 26 September for my dad's 70th birthday, booked in August with a $200 deposit for the private room (confirmation attached). When we arrived we were seated in the main dining room by the kitchen door, and nobody told us why. The food and our servers were lovely; the room was the thing we'd paid extra for. I'd like the $200 deposit refunded. Could you let me know by Friday 2 October?
Thanks,
Laura Chen, 555-0187
note: Credit what was good in one clause, then ask for the one thing that maps to the failure: the deposit, not the whole bill.

situation: 家里装修，卫生间瓷砖9月21日铺完，没几天就发现有三块空鼓。27号和28号两次微信找项目经理孙经理都没回。合同写了保修一年，想直接给装修公司客服发个正式的投诉。
reply: 您好，我是翠湖花园3栋1802的业主赵磊，合同号 JZ-2026-0715。卫生间瓷砖9月21日铺完，9月27日发现有三块空鼓，照片和视频附后。9月27日和28日我两次微信联系项目经理孙经理，目前都没有回复。按合同约定的一年保修，请安排师傅上门，重新铺贴这三块瓷砖。希望在10月9日周五前确定上门时间。我的电话是 138 1077 4521，谢谢。
note: Written escalation over a silent contact: cite the contract clause and dated attempts so the next reader can act without asking.

situation: Just checked into the Marlowe Hotel in Boston for 3 nights for a conference. Room 614 reeks of cigarette smoke and I booked non-smoking. Heading down to the front desk now, what do I say?
reply: Hi, I'm Priya Nair, I've just checked into room 614 for three nights, out on Friday. I booked a non-smoking room, and 614 smells strongly of cigarette smoke, enough that I can't sleep in it. I'd like to move to a non-smoking room tonight, ideally within the hour since I have an early start. I'm happy to wait here while you check.
note: In person the same structure works out loud: who you are, the fact, the specific fix and a time, then stay calm and stay at the desk.

situation: My language app (Lingora) auto-renewed my annual plan for $119 on Sept 26. I forgot to cancel, which is on me, and I haven't opened it since June. I want to ask for a refund without pretending it was their fault.
reply:
Hi,
My annual Lingora Plus plan, account maya.reyes@mailbox.com, auto-renewed on 26 September for $119. That's my mistake: I meant to cancel before the renewal and missed it. I haven't used the app since June and haven't opened it since the charge. Could you cancel the plan and refund the $119 as a one-off? I'd be grateful for a reply by Friday 2 October.
Thanks,
Maya Reyes
note: When the slip is partly yours, say so in one line; owning it is what makes a goodwill refund easy to grant.

situation: Returned a $219 pair of hiking boots to Trailhead Outfitters on Sept 4, tracking shows they got them Sept 8. I emailed on Sept 15 and Sept 22 asking where my refund is and got no reply to either. Order TO-88412.
reply:
Hi,
Order TO-88412: I returned the Ridgeline hiking boots on 4 September, and tracking shows you received them on 8 September (screenshot attached). I emailed on 15 and 22 September about the $219 refund and haven't had a reply. Please refund the $219 to my original card. If it hasn't been issued by Friday 9 October, I'll raise a chargeback with my card provider.
Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz, 555-0163
note: After two unanswered emails, stop repeating the ask: name the next step and its date once, then take it if the date passes.

situation: My Skyvale Airways flight from Lisbon to Amsterdam on Sept 18, booking ref K7Q2MD, was cancelled the night before for 'operational reasons'. They rebooked me the next evening, I paid €142 for a hotel near the airport, and I missed a paid day of a conference. I want to claim what I'm owed.
reply: Hello, booking reference K7Q2MD. My flight from Lisbon to Amsterdam on 18 September was cancelled the evening before for operational reasons, and I was rebooked on the next evening's flight. I paid €142 for a hotel near the airport that night (receipt attached). I'm requesting the €400 compensation due under EU Regulation 261/2004 for a cancellation with less than 14 days' notice on a route of this distance, plus reimbursement of the €142 hotel. Please confirm within 14 days. Thank you, Hannah Weiss, hannah.weiss@mailbox.org
note: The missed conference day isn't covered by EU261, so leave it out: a claim that asks only for what's due is the easiest one to approve.

situation: 网上买的空气净化器，订单号8820417736，9月17日签收，今天开机就报E3故障。客服回复说过了7天无理由，只能寄回厂家维修，要等30天左右。我想要换新，不想吵架。
reply: 您好，谢谢回复。寄修解决不了我的问题：订单号8820417736的空气净化器9月17日签收，9月29日开机报E3故障，签收还不到15天。按三包规定，15天内出现性能故障可以直接换货。麻烦转给主管或售后专员处理，我的要求还是换一台新机。希望10月8日（周四）前能给我答复，我更希望和你们直接解决这件事。
note: 第一次被话术拒绝，只升级一次：重申订单事实、依据和一个要求，给个期限，不在第一次升级里提差评或投诉平台。

situation: Brightwater Energy sent me a $412 bill for August, marked 'estimated read'. My usual bill is about $95. I took a photo of the meter this morning and it reads 18,442. Account number 7710-2294.
reply: Hi, I'm writing about account 7710-2294. My August bill came to $412 on an estimated read; my usual monthly bill is about $95. I photographed the meter this morning, Tuesday September 29, and it reads 18,442 (photo attached). Please reissue the August bill using this actual reading, and hold the $412 autopay until it's corrected. Could you confirm by Friday, October 2? Thanks, Dana Morales, 555-0142
note: An estimated bill is usually fixed by one dated, photographed reading; ask for the reissue, not a discount.

situation: My broadband provider Fibrenet charged me a £96 early exit fee when I left on 1 September, but my contract ended on 30 June and I have the contract PDF. I emailed, then asked for a manager; today their complaints team sent a 'final response' saying the fee stands.
reply:
Thanks for confirming your position. My contract on account FN-603118 ended on 30 June (page 2 of the contract, attached again), so an early exit fee doesn't apply to my leaving on 1 September. As this is your final response, I'll take the £96 charge to the Communications Ombudsman and reference this thread. If you'd rather settle it directly, a refund to my original card by Friday 9 October would close it on my side.
Kind regards,
Imogen Hart
note: After a final response, stop arguing with the same inbox: name the next step once, leave one clean way to settle, then take it.

situation: My 78-year-old dad went to the Ashford Street branch of Northgate Bank on Thursday Sept 24 to update his address. The teller sighed, told him loudly to 'just use the app like everyone else', and didn't help him. I don't want money, I want an apology and for someone to actually help him.
reply: Hello, I'm writing on behalf of my father, Harold Price, a customer at your Ashford Street branch, with his permission and with him copied in. On Thursday 24 September, around 11am, he went in to update his address; the teller sighed, told him loudly to 'just use the app like everyone else', and did not help him. He is 78 and does not use the app. I'm asking for two things: an apology to him, and an in-branch appointment in October where someone updates his address with him. Could you reply by Tuesday 13 October?
note: When the want is an apology and a fix, say so plainly; it is easier to grant than an open-ended complaint.

situation: My local dry cleaner shrank my wool coat, the sleeves came back about 5cm shorter. The cleaning was $18 and the coat cost $320 two years ago. I've used them for years and the owner, Mr. Kim, is usually lovely, so I'm going in tomorrow to talk to him.
reply: Hi Mr. Kim, I've got a problem with my coat and I'm hoping you can help me sort it. I dropped it off last Monday, ticket 4471, and it came back with the sleeves about 5cm shorter; I've brought it and the care label, which says dry clean only. I bought it two years ago for $320. What I'd like is the $18 cleaning refunded and $150 toward a replacement. Is that something you can do?
note: With a local business you want to keep using, the in-person script and a proportionate ask (about half, since the coat is two years old) keep the relationship intact.

situation: 网上买了一副699元的降噪耳机，运单号773014288375。物流9月28日下午显示“已签收，签收人：门卫”，但小区门卫说那天没代收过我的件。给派件员打了两次电话都没人接，想在快递公司官方客服正式投诉。
reply: 您好，运单号773014288375，收件人王磊，地址滨江花园3栋。物流显示9月28日下午3点16分“已签收，签收人：门卫”，但我本人没有收到，小区门卫也确认当天没有代收这个件（门卫代收登记的照片已附）。9月28日和29日我两次打派件员电话，都没人接。请帮我核实签收记录和派送照片，把包裹找回；如果找不回，请按商品价值699元理赔。麻烦在10月3日（周六）前给我答复，电话139 0215 6678，谢谢。
note: 先要求核实签收记录，再说清找不回时要什么；能赔多少以运单上的保价条款为准，发之前先看一眼。

situation: Alquilé un coche en el aeropuerto de Málaga del 19 al 26 de septiembre, contrato MLG-558210. Al devolverlo me cobraron 350 € por un arañazo en el paragolpes trasero que ya estaba cuando lo recogí; tengo tres fotos que hice en el aparcamiento de recogida el 19 a las 10:42. Quiero reclamarlo por escrito.
reply:
Hola:
Contrato MLG-558210, alquiler en el aeropuerto de Málaga del 19 al 26 de septiembre. Al devolver el coche se me cargaron 350 € por un arañazo en el paragolpes trasero. Ese arañazo ya estaba cuando lo recogí: adjunto tres fotos tomadas el 19 de septiembre a las 10:42 en el aparcamiento de recogida, donde se ve con claridad. Les pido que anulen el cargo y me devuelvan los 350 € a la tarjeta con la que pagué. ¿Pueden confirmarlo antes del viernes 9 de octubre?
Gracias,
Lucía Ferrer, 612 345 678
note: Las fotos con fecha y hora hacen el trabajo; pide solo que anulen ese cargo y guarda el contrato y las fotos por si hay que escalar.
